## 主业务闭环（Controller / Service 执行流）

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph product [商品]
    PC[ColonelActivityProductController]
    PS[ProductService]
  end
  subgraph order [订单]
    OSJ[OrderSyncJob]
    OSS[OrderSyncService]
    AS[AttributionService]
  end
  subgraph sample [寄样]
    SC[SampleController]
    SLS[SampleLifecycleService]
  end
  subgraph talent [达人]
    TC[TalentController]
  end
  subgraph perf [业绩]
    PCS[PerformanceCalculationService]
  end
  subgraph dash [分析]
    DC[DashboardController]
  end
  PC --> PS
  PS -->|pick_source_mapping| OSS
  OSJ --> OSS --> AS
  OSS --> SLS
  TC --> SC
  PS --> SC
  AS --> PCS
  AS --> DC
  PCS --> DC
```
